title: Pavlova
description: Crisp-shelled meringue with a soft marshmallow centre, topped with whipped cream and fresh seasonal fruit. An Australian icon.

ingredients.item: Fresh fruit — kiwi, strawberries, passionfruit, mango

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 120°C. Draw a 22cm circle on baking paper and place on a tray.
Whip egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually add caster sugar, beating until thick and very glossy.
Gently fold in vinegar, cornflour and vanilla.
Mound mixture onto the circle with a slight dip in the centre for the cream.
Bake for 90 minutes. Turn oven off — leave pavlova inside to cool completely. Do not open the door.
Top with whipped cream and fresh fruit just before service.
